title: fix(mcp): use the root endpoint and improve model discovery
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Serves Streamable HTTP directly at `https://mcp.pollinations.ai`; health moves to `/health` and `/mcp` returns 404.
- Switches the managed-agent runtime and dashboard to the same root endpoint.
- Improves server instructions and tool descriptions so agents consult the live model registry.
- Documents hosted bearer authentication and validates image resource links.
- Ensures MCP source changes trigger the relevant deployment/docs workflow.

Validation:
- Hosted Worker tests: 5/5
- Authenticated MCP smoke suite: 11/11
- Managed-agent runtime tests: 20/20
- Enter typecheck and staging build
- Wrangler production dry-run
- Biome and diff checks

gist.headline: MCP finds the front door
gist.blurb: The MCP server now answers at its root URL, where sensible protocols tend to look first. Agents also get clearer directions to the live model registry, because guessing which models exist is a surprisingly expensive hobby.
gist.summary: MCP Streamable HTTP is now served directly at https://mcp.pollinations.ai, with health checks at /health, while managed agents and the dashboard use the same root endpoint and server guidance points agents to the live model registry.
gist.impact: Agents and hosted MCP clients can connect through one canonical endpoint, discover current models from the registry, authenticate with documented bearer auth, and receive validated image resource links.
gist.visual_concept: Depict MCP as a cozy garden gateway: Polli guides a small CRT monitor robot through a clearly marked root entrance toward a living model registry, represented by labeled code-plants growing from pots. A /health sign sits on a side path, while the main gate reads mcp.pollinations.ai, making the canonical route visually obvious.
